name: google-ai-search-mcp
description: Google AI search and technical documentation tools for MCP clients.
long_description: Seven tools for web-grounded technical research, documentation retrieval, code analysis, technology comparisons, project guidance, and architecture review using the Gemini API.

tools.name: answer_query_websearch
tools.description: Answer a technical question using Google Search grounding.

tools.name: explain_topic_with_docs
tools.description: Explain a software topic using current official documentation.

tools.name: get_doc_snippets
tools.description: Retrieve concise technical answers and code snippets from documentation.

tools.name: generate_project_guidelines
tools.description: Generate project guidance for a specified technology stack.

tools.name: code_analysis_with_docs
tools.description: Review code against current documentation and implementation guidance.

tools.name: architecture_pattern_recommendation
tools.description: Recommend architecture patterns for supplied requirements and a technology stack.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: API key used for Gemini requests. The key is stored as a sensitive value by the host.
